messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: New releases: simmer.bricks, simmer.plot
parts:
Hi everyone,

New versions of simmer.bricks and simmer.plot have hit CRAN during the
last days. simmer.bricks has bumped minor release because it incudes
some small API changes in functions "do_parallel" and
"delayed_release". It also includes the new function "interleave",
which implements a pattern for interleaving resources as discussed in
this list. simmer.plot only includes some minor fixes. Here are the
complete changelogs:

https://r-simmer.org/extensions/plot/news/index.html#simmer-plot-0-1-14
https://r-simmer.org/extensions/bricks/news/index.html#simmer-bricks-0-2-0

Regards,
Iñaki
